Änderungswünsche zu Geschlechtseinträgen nehmen deutlich ab

en.title: Hundreds of Germans Change Gender Entries Under Self‑Determination Law
en.dek: In 2026, 4,620 people used Germany’s self‑determination law to change their gender entry, while requests have fallen sharply since the law’s 2024 introduction.
facts: 4,620 people changed gender entry in 2026 under the law.
31,493 people have changed gender entry nationwide since the law took effect on 1 November 2024.
More than 600 people in Mecklenburg‑Vorpommern used the law in 2026.
Requests for changes fell from 10,589 in late 2024 to 15,688 in 2025, and 4,620 in 2026.
body: The self‑determination law entered German law on 1 November 2024, allowing people to change their gender entry at a registry office with a simple statement, and the Federal Statistical Office reports that 31,493 individuals have used the law nationwide since its enactment. The law has simplified the process compared to previous procedures. The change is recorded in official civil status documents.

In Mecklenburg‑Vorpommern, more than 600 people used the law in 2026, according to the state’s statistical office. The region’s figures show a decline from 10,589 changes in the last two months of 2024 to 15,688 in 2025, and 4,620 in 2026. The highest number of changes occurred in January 2025, when 2,360 entries were updated, while December 2025 saw only 636 changes.

In the city of Rostock, a city speaker reported that 109 people changed their gender entry in the final two months of 2024, 72 did so in the entire 2025, and 56 have done so so far in 2026. The speaker noted that the initial surge after the law’s introduction has moderated. The city’s registry offices have seen a steady decline in requests.

In 2025, the Federal Statistical Office recorded that 42 percent of changes were from female to male, 27 percent from male to female, 20 percent from female to diverse, and 9 percent from male to diverse. These percentages reflect the varied motivations for gender entry changes under the law.
The law also recorded 106 male‑to‑female and 193 female‑to‑male changes in the northeast in 2025, and 93 changes were classified as "Other" by the Federal Statistical Office.
en.context: The self‑determination law, which took effect on 1 November 2024, permits individuals to change their gender entry at a registry office with a simple statement. It replaced a more complicated procedure that previously required additional documentation.

problemsFixed: Headline was vague and did not include key figures; it should state the exact number of changes. The dek used the phrase "fell sharply" without attributing the claim to a source. Fact 4 incorrectly mixed Mecklenburg‑Vorpommern and nationwide numbers. The body contained an interpretive sentence about motivations and repeated sentence openings. The body also omitted explicit attribution for the claim that the law simplifies the process.
